title: translation variance record
description: How one Daodejing/Yijing term is rendered across published English translations, set beside this section's own house reading. One shared shape for every term in this glossary that carries a translation-variance record, rather than one near-identical JSON Schema per term: dao, de, wu-wei, ziran, pu, and daodejing all instantiate this same structure, parameterized by `term`, `hanzi`, `pinyin`, `locus`, `translations`, and `houseTranslation` — the mechanics of comparing translators do not vary by which term is being compared. Each term's own thin schema (e.g. dao.schema.json) fixes `term` and $refs this file, mirroring how functor.schema.json $refs the shared category.schema.json rather than restating category structure per functor.

term.description: the glossary term identity this record is about; must equal the filename stem of the paired content/text/glossary/terms/<term>.md carrier

hanzi.description: the term's Chinese characters as written in the received text

pinyin.description: the term's pinyin romanization with tone marks

locus.description: the Daodejing chapter(s), or other textual location, where the term is discussed

translations.description: grounded renderings of the term by named published translators, most-central locus first

houseTranslation.description: this section's own reading of the term, graded in the estate's own [B]/PROVED/FRAMING/VALVE vocabulary rather than asserted as a resolution of the translations compared above
